name: @pipeworx/mcp-besttime

tools.name: besttime_forecast
tools.description: How busy is <venue> by hour/day (foot-traffic forecast) — creates a busyness forecast for a public venue (restaurant, bar, gym, store, museum) by name + address. Returns the 24-hour busyness curve (0-100) for each weekday plus busy/quiet/peak hours and a venue_id for later queries. Example: besttime_forecast({ venue_name: "McDonald's", venue_address: "Ocean Ave, San Francisco", _apiKey: "pri_xxx:pub_yyy" })

venue_address.description: Business address, e.g. "1 Market St, San Francisco, CA" (max 1024 chars)

_apiKey.description: BestTime keys as "privateKey:publicKey" (pri_.../pub_...) from your besttime.app account (free test account available)

tools.name: besttime_query
tools.description: Busyness for a venue at a specific hour or day — reads an already-forecasted venue (by venue_id from besttime_forecast). Pass `hour` for a single hour, or omit it to get the whole day's curve. Example: besttime_query({ venue_id: "ven_...", day: 4, hour: 18, _apiKey: "pri_xxx:pub_yyy" })

hour.description: Hour of day 0-23 (optional). If given, returns that hour's busyness intensity.

day.description: Day of week 0-6 (0=Monday … 6=Sunday). Defaults to 0 (Monday) if omitted.

tools.name: besttime_live
tools.description: Is <venue> busy right now vs usual — returns live foot-traffic busyness compared to the forecasted level for this hour. Identify the venue by venue_id, or by venue_name + venue_address. Example: besttime_live({ venue_name: "Blue Bottle Coffee", venue_address: "66 Mint St, San Francisco", _apiKey: "pri_xxx:pub_yyy" })

venue_id.description: Venue id from besttime_forecast (fastest). Alternative to venue_name+venue_address.

venue_name.description: Business name (required if venue_id not given)

venue_address.description: Business address (required if venue_id not given)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-besttime forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the besttime pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
